title: The Alignment Problem
description: How do we make AI systems do what we actually want? Explore from early safety research through RLHF to Constitutional AI and the emerging regulatory landscape.
targetAudience: Anyone concerned with AI safety and governance
keyTakeaways: Alignment ensures AI pursues goals beneficial to humans
RLHF trains models using human preference comparisons
Constitutional AI uses explicit principles for self-critique
The EU AI Act established the first comprehensive AI regulation
